name: James Trezvant
bio: a Representative from Virginia; born in Sussex County, Va., birth date unknown; completed preparatory studies; studied law; was admitted to the bar and commenced practice in Jerusalem, Va.; attorney general of Virginia; delegate to the Virginia state constitutional convention in 1820; served in the Virginia state house of delegates; elected as a Jacksonian candidate to the Nineteenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (March 4, 1825-March 3, 1831); chairman, Committee on Military Pensions (Twenty-first Congress); died in Southampton County, Va., September 2, 1841.
